metaDescription: Apply for the Supervisor role at Firestone Fire and Security Systems, a civil defence approved fire protection contractor in the UAE.

blocks.text: We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Supervisor to oversee fire and safety projects and maintenance activities. The ideal candidate will manage site teams, coordinate day-to-day operations, and ensure compliance with safety standards, project requirements, and company policies.

items: Supervise site teams during installation, testing, and maintenance of fire and safety systems.
Assign tasks, monitor progress, and ensure timely project execution.
Conduct daily site inspections to ensure quality and safety compliance.
Coordinate with engineers, project managers, and contractors.
Provide technical guidance and resolve on-site challenges.
Maintain accurate records of manpower, work progress, and daily reports.
Ensure adherence to NFPA, civil defense, and local fire authority standards.
Train and guide technicians to follow proper safety and work procedures.
Proven experience as a Supervisor in fire & safety or MEP projects.
Strong knowledge of fire protection and alarm systems.
Ability to manage manpower and handle multiple tasks.
Good leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Physically fit and willing to work on-site.
Certification in Fire & Safety or related field.
Knowledge of integrated systems (fire alarms, pumps, sprinklers, BMS).
Site-based role across various project locations.
May involve extended hours, emergency calls, or weekend duties.
PPE and tools will be provided by the company.

title: Supervisor
